name: Bela
overview: The name Bela appears in Scripture referring to multiple distinct subjects: a city also known as Zoar, a king of Edom, and a son of Benjamin. The city of Bela, or Zoar, was one of the five cities involved in the conflict described in Genesis 14, highlighting its historical significance. Bela as a king of Edom ruled from the city of Dinhabah, illustrating the lineage and governance within Edom. Additionally, Bela is noted as a son of Benjamin, called Belah, from whom the Belaites descended, emphasizing the tribal heritage within Israel.
